Tracing the startup chain from main to locate the component responsible for keeping attachment links fresh.

Locating where `startBackgroundRunners` is called.

I have identified the component, schedule, and wiring location for the stale attachment link issue.

The component is `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`. It refreshes S3 attachment presigned URLs via `CheckAndPresign`. It schedules runs every 12 hours via `runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12` at line 27. It also runs once immediately on startup via `RunOnce(ctx)`. The wiring site is `server/server.go`.

The wiring site is `server/server.go:129`, where `Start()` calls `startBackgroundRunners(ctx)`. That function creates and starts the runner at lines 161–171.
